MASTER_PAD_VERSION_INFO.MASTER_PAD_INFO: Portable Application Description (PAD) file for Bitcoin Price Predictor, a Windows BTCUSDT projection and charting tool.

Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Initial public release of Bitcoin Price Predictor v1.00 for Windows. Includes BTCUSDT 15-minute data loading, historical candle download on first run, calibration rebuild, probability path visualization, projection bands, alerts, chart tools, and export-focused research features.
Program_Info.Program_System_Requirements: Windows 10 or Windows 11. Internet connection recommended for BTCUSDT market data updates. The standalone installer includes the required Python runtime and packages.

Expire_Info.Expire_Other_Info: No fixed expiration configured in the provided package.

English.Keywords: bitcoin price predictor, BTCUSDT, Bitcoin charting, crypto projection, price projection, market visualization, cryptocurrency analysis, Bitcoin alerts, chart overlays, projection bands
English.Char_Desc_80: Bitcoin Price Predictor is a BTCUSDT projection and charting tool for Windows.
English.Char_Desc_250: Bitcoin Price Predictor is a Windows BTCUSDT market visualization and price projection tool that displays recent Bitcoin price movement, possible future projection paths, probability bands, alerts, bookmarks, chart overlays, and export options.
English.Char_Desc_450: Bitcoin Price Predictor is a Windows BTCUSDT market visualization and price projection tool. It helps users review recent Bitcoin movement, possible future projection paths, probability bands, horizon markers, chart overlays, configurable alerts, bookmarks, calibration rebuilds, and exports to PDF, CSV, and XLSX. It is a research and visualization tool only, not financial advice or a trading bot.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Bitcoin Price Predictor is a Windows BTCUSDT market visualization and price projection tool. It displays recent Bitcoin price movement together with possible future projection paths, probability bands, horizon markers, chart overlays, configurable alerts, bookmarks, calibration rebuild tools, and export options. The software is intended for informational, educational, research, and visualization purposes only. It is not a trading bot and does not provide financial, investment, or trading advice.
